cues.title: Aloha
cues.note: [The explosion becomes the true-story joke, then Aloha.]

cues.title: A new contact
cues.note: Your C-arm has entered the chat. Disconnected. Feeling ghosted.

cues.title: The message
cues.note: Patch overdue. It needs to talk. About its firmware.

cues.title: Space
cues.note: Updating. Personal growth in progress.

cues.title: Care
cues.note: Connected and current. Somebody cared.

cues.title: The honest state
cues.note: When something fails, it says so.

cues.title: Recovery
cues.note: Recovery gets its own personality too.

cues.title: Switch
cues.note: [Let the accelerating loop collapse.]

cues.title: Now
cues.note: [Pause. The room turns dark.]

cues.title: The night shift
cues.note: Now the hospital has an evening to plan. Care continues. Our work has to fit around it.

cues.title: An opening
cues.note: A cancellation opens a gap.

cues.title: The scouts
cues.note: Specialists search the plan, device state and maintenance requirements together.

cues.title: Protect the care
cues.note: Then they challenge the opportunity: enough time to recover, emergency demand, another device available.

cues.title: The thread
cues.note: This is the eligible window our prototype finds. A proposal, with a reason.

cues.title: Find
cues.note: Now follow the handoff. The opportunity enters one coordinated service plan.

cues.title: Decide
cues.note: Medical physics reviews it. A named person authorizes the start.

cues.title: Help
cues.note: Our robot concept brings power and an approved data connection to the parked machine.

cues.title: Account
cues.note: The result comes back. A problem stays open until someone owns it. Our working demo makes those handoffs visible; clinical integrations come next.

cues.title: The next case
cues.note: The machine has a care team, too.

cues.title: Ready
cues.note: So your attention can stay on what comes next. [Hold the final image.]
